title: Keep the Meadow scene at 100% scale on both macOS and Android
context: The 2026-10-03 device check installed seeded side-by-side builds at pre-sweep, 100%, 85% and 75% scene scale on the Note 10+ and the Mac. On the phone, 85% looked the same as 100% at 2x zoom and 75% slightly softer. Scene images take 271 MB at 100%, 198 MB at 85% and 156 MB at 75%. Neither step-down fixes the noon frame rate (40.8 and 43.5 fps against 36) or the sharpening hitch.
outcome: The owner said "The `s100` version is acceptable on both macOS and Android." meadowSceneScaleAndroid and meadowSceneScaleMacos stay at 1.0; no code change. Recorded in the sweep decisions file.
